messages:
deploybot: Scheduled migration windows: 'orders:add_order_status' starting in ~20m on prod-01. Plan summary: apply enum change (fast DDL), add nullable col, run batched backfill, validate uniqueness on replica, then hard-apply NOT NULL + index. Quiesce window 5m. Pinned service image services/order@v1.42 for the rollout. Holdpoint at 'pre-backfill-check'. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/ops/migrations/orders-add-order-status.

sam: Oncall — I can lead the cutover. What exactly triggers the holdpoint?

deploybot: Holdpoint triggers: stop after enum add + col add + one small smoke. Manual approval required at pre-backfill-check or auto-abort if lock >30s.

liam: Re backfill rate: 1000/s seems high for peak. Suggest 250/s and use traffic-shed to canary clusters during backfill. Also recommend warming KV cache before switching. :thinking_face:

emily: +1 to lower rate. 300/s is a good middle ground. I'll pin app config to services/order:1.42 so enum parsing stays consistent.

prateek: Rollback prepared: revert_enum_20260320.sql and backfill-cancel.sh. If lock holds >30s we abort and run revert. Devops snippet I will use during window:

```
kubectl rollout pause deployment/orders
psql -h prod-01 -c "SELECT pid, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE orders%';"
# if lock found >30s -> trigger revert script
```

sam: I'll watch locks and post periodic snapshots. I'll also create the one-line release note for #announcements after successful swap.

oncall-sre: If replication lag >30s during backfill, pause batch workers. I'll add an alert: backfill_replication_lag > 30s for 2m -> pager. Also watch p95 latency delta.

emily: Canary plan: eu-west1 first at 5% traffic for 10m. Metrics to gate: p95 latency, error rate, DB lock time, replication lag. If any gate trips -> rollback. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Deploybot: will start canary in 10m. Auto-abort conditions: >5% 5xx, p95 latency >= +40% baseline, lock >30s, replication lag >30s. Will update thread with step markers.

sam: Ack. Manual holdpoint recorded. Ready on my side, standing by to abort if necessary.
